d:
At some point Tohsaka Tokiomi stated to develop feelings for his daughter Rin, unknown to his wife Aoi.
Whenever he took a bath with her, he taught her things like 'you should never undress before any boy besides daddy' or 'only daddy is allowed to touch you'.
Of course Rin believed him.
Even though his manhood wasn't big, he teached her that he had an impressive size, not comparable to others.
Rin believed him.
